_comment: Adapter assignments for Wind's Spellbooks 1.0.1 on NeoForge 1.21.1, read from each spell's bytecode (onCast) and verified by WindSpellbooksGameTests.

wind_spellbooks:aeropic.reason: Applies the Acrobatics effect to the caster.

wind_spellbooks:almighty_push.reason: Spawns an AlmightyPushEntity on the caster that pushes everything around it away.

wind_spellbooks:iron_slash.reason: A charged dash that computes its own path from the caster's look (ClipContext) before Iron's teleport helper; no adapter can place that path at an Ars target, so it is catalogued dormant.

wind_spellbooks:tailwind.reason: Applies the Tailwind effect to the caster.

wind_spellbooks:tornado.reason: Not castable with Iron's 1.21.1-3.16.3 even natively: Wind's Spellbooks 1.0.1's TornadoEntity constructor reads a field this Iron's build does not have (NoSuchFieldError: fireTransitionTick), observed in the -PwithWindSpellbooks GameTest profile; catalogued dormant until a compatible Wind's Spellbooks build.

wind_spellbooks:wind_blade.reason: Launches a WindBladeProjectile along the caster's look.

wind_spellbooks:wind_jump.reason: Launches the caster upward with slow falling and a gust collider at its own position.
